inputs.text: Martin is pointing to increased tenancies, but that may be a reassuring number that distracts from what’s worsening: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and national emergency accommodation numbers have climbed again. The six-year lease rules the Government introduced on March 1 may be part of what’s driving this, rather than evidence the crisis is being solved. They want people to focus on more tenancies instead of asking who is being pushed out—and why.

output.main_topic: Rising housing insecurity despite increased tenancies
subtopics: Framing tenancy increases as a distraction
